thread:
ana: Quick sync — we need to pick priorities for private packaging+upgrade behavior. Customers are split between a fully airgap installer and minimal in-place upgrades with zero-downtime. I want a short list of launch gates and suggested order. (cc @darin @mika)

darin: Can we call out constraints first? K8s vs. VM installs change the upgrade strategy a lot. In-place zero-downtime needs rolling agent + backwards-compatible wire protocol.

mika: From field: several customers (fintech + healthcare) asked for per-node upgrade windows and explicit latency SLOs during upgrade. Airgap is a blocker for them but they care more about predictable upgrades.

karen: +1. ACME Health asked for a safe rollback path and an ops playbook. They won't accept "reinstall" as a rollback.

suresh: Security: any auto-upgrade path must support KMS key rotation and cert pinning. For airgap we need signed bundles + offline signature verification. Also HSM/enterprise KMS integration is non-negotiable for some customers.

ops: Packaging options we discussed:

- deb/rpm + systemd unit (VMs)
- container images + helm chart / k8s operator
- single tarball with bootstrap script (airgap)

Example of manifest we expect for tarball installs:
```
apiVersion: redwood/v1
kind: installer
spec:
  edition: private
  components:
    - agent: 2.4.1
    - runtime: 1.17.0
  signature: sha256:...
```

deploy-bot: build/installer-bundle 1715234600 created: artifacts/installer-2.4.1.tar.gz :package:

ana: Proposed MVP acceptance criteria (short):
- Installer options: k8s (helm) OR tarball airgap OR deb/rpm
- Upgrade: support rolling upgrades for k8s operator + staged node upgrade for VMs
- Rollback: documented fast rollback <= 30m for common failure modes
- Security: signed bundles + KMS/HSM integration documented
- Networking: support VPC peering and static route connector (no managed NAT in MVP)
- Reliability: >99% successful upgrades in internal staging across 3 clusters

mika: Prioritization suggestion (customer-impact order):
1) K8s operator + rolling upgrade (biggest demand)
2) Airgap installer + signed bundles (regulated customers)
3) Per-node scheduling / maintenance window support
4) Simplified VPC connector (agent-side NAT traversal later)

darin: Rough engineering estimates (very coarse):
- K8s operator + rolling logic: 4w (core) + 2w tests
- Airgap installer + signature verification: 3w + 1w ops tests
- VM per-node scheduling: 2w
- VPC connector UX + docs: 1w

suresh: Add launch gate: must pass security checklist including threat model update, offline-signature audit, and KMS rotation test. Also document key lifecycle for Private customers.

karen: Also need migration playbook + customer comms template before GA. Add a pre-req that SEs have a migration checklist.

ana: OK — action items:
- @darin: scope operator + rolling upgrade (owner) — ETA 2024-04-15
- @mika: draft airgap installer spec + signature flow — ETA 2024-04-01
- @suresh: security gating checklist + KMS test cases — ETA 2024-03-29
- @karen: migration playbook + comms template — ETA 2024-04-05
- @ops: add staging jobs to run upgrade smoke across 3 clusters — ETA 2024-03-28

ana: If no major objections I'll slot this into the next planning cycle and share a condensed spec doc.

darin: LGTM, we should also capture compatibility matrix for older runtime versions so rolling upgrades are explicit.

mika: I'll open a customer-impact doc and add the ACME Health notes.

suresh: Will add HSM notes to the checklist.

ana: Thanks everyone — will follow up with a spec and PRD link later today. :thumbsup:
